description: Check one FactLot fact against the published fact schema (spec/schemas/fact.json): subject URN, dotted predicate, as_of date, provenance, optional rights; unknown fields are rejected at every level. Rules: every fact except a computed one cites at least one source (an inferred fact cites the evidence it was inferred from); a computed fact names its formula or cites a source; valid_from is not after valid_to; a source span does not end before it starts. For Ingest predicates (lease.expiration_date, lease.rentable_area_sf, lease.base_rent_schedule, ...) the value must have the predicate's shape and every source quote must state the value, by the same written-form rules as doc_verify_facts (a quote saying "2,500 square feet" does not support 1000). Not checked: that the quote is in the document, that the document or sha256 exists, that supersedes IDs exist, and quotes for other predicates; doc_verify_facts with the document's pages checks the quote. Returns { valid, issues }. Call before storing or sharing facts.

fact.description: A FactLot fact: subject, predicate, value, as_of, provenance (with sources), optional rights.
